checks: Private conversation IDs/URLs and local source paths
Capture epochs and dated capture filenames
Source-specific absolute-odometer ranges and raw odometer byte examples; workbook/map review
manual_review: Current year-specific docs and confidence boundaries
Historical warning banners and workbook current-qualification columns
Odometer slots withheld in the80-byte historical mask table
No original payload/trip-grid/media/private source archive included
Publication made from a new clean directory, without Git history
Stationary reference pairs use relative time only
excluded: Original full-CAN and focused source logs
Original photographs, video, audio and workbook binary
Private input hashes, identities, capture clocks and absolute odometers
Private build scripts and compiled Python bytecode
limitations: Distinctive research and vehicle pairing may be recognizable
The publishing account and future commit metadata can identify authorship
Previously shared copies and future additions are outside this review
scope: Privacy-reduced technical publication. This is not a claim that every original source can be redistributed or that removed information is irrecoverable elsewhere.
